messages:
alex: T-45 until change window starts at 21:00 UTC. Quick readiness tick: pin, canary, backups, observability.

morgan: On it. I have the dashboards open. Who is primary for rollback?

sarah: I'll own rollback and post commands if we need them. Lee is standby.

alex: @deploy-bot please pin release v2026.03.21-rc3 to production groups api, embeddings now.

deploy-bot: Command received: `/pin v2026.03.21-rc3 -> production (api, embeddings)`. Pins applied to 3 node groups. :white_check_mark:

morgan: Confirmed. Backups completed at 20:50 UTC. Snapshot id: snap-20260321-2050

lee: Canary routing set to 5% traffic. Observability tag: canary=v2026.03.21-rc3

alex: Reminder: freeze window in effect until +2h post-rollout. No hotfixes without exec approval. Keep PRs staged but do not merge.

sarah: If we need to rollback, steps in order:
1) `/pin v2026.03.19` (previous stable)
2) `/deploy rollback --groups api,embeddings --reason "canary errors"`
3) `/migrate rollback 20260319_reverse` if migrations are implicated
I'll run those if we hit the rollback criteria.

sarah: Pasteable snippet:
```
/pin v2026.03.19
/deploy rollback --groups api,embeddings --reason "canary errors"
/migrate rollback 20260319_reverse
```

deploy-bot: Snapshot created for rollback readiness: snap-rollback-ready-1717774200. Canary routing ready to start.

oncall-bot: Paging ops oncall: sarah, lee for coverage 21:00-23:00 UTC. Please ack.

morgan: Observability thresholds set: latency target <120ms, token error rate <0.2%. Alerts on Slack channel if breached.

alex: Release notes live: https://redwood-internal/release/2026-03-21-rc3 — callouts for change to cache/batching behavior and opt-in flags for embeddings.

lee: If we see embedding cost/latency spike, plan is to throttle embeddings and divert to fallback model `embed-lite-v1`.

morgan: Running quick smoke now: `curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.dev/health` -> 200 OK, sample generation tests ok.

alex: Plan: ramp canary at 21:05 UTC to 5%. Observe for 10 minutes. If metrics stay good, increment per ramp schedule. If breach, rollback within 10m.

sarah: Acknowledged. I'll trigger rollback steps immediately if we cross thresholds or see >1% user-facing errors.

morgan: :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary ramp to 5% at 21:05 UTC complete. Traffic snapshot: total 85k/min, canary ~4k/min.

lee: Observing slight tail latency increase on pod-7, pulling logs: `/logs pod-7` — investigating.

morgan: Seeing some 429 spikes from model cache misses. I'm adjusting batching thresholds and cache warmup params now.

alex: If the latency doesn't stabilize after config adjust, execute rollback. Keep all notes here for postmortem.

lee: Applied hotpatch to batching config on canary nodes. Latency stabilized, error rate back under 0.1%.

sarah: Good. I'll hold off rollback. Proceed with slow ramp to 25% in 15m, then monitor.

alex: After ramp completes and metrics are green, we'll wait 30m then do full rollout at ~21:40 UTC. Freeze still holds until 23:15 UTC (+2h post final rollout).

morgan: Noted. Recording incident flag if any manual unpinning occurs.

lee: Small operational note: updated runbook with cache threshold change and command used — will add to release notes.

sarah: Final check: all stakeholders acked on Slack and ops. If anything new appears, call the rollback lane.

alex: Great run. Full rollout completed at 21:42 UTC. Freeze lift scheduled for 23:15 UTC, will confirm when done.

deploy-bot: Release state: `v2026.03.21-rc3 -> production (api, embeddings)`. Full rollout complete. :tada:

alex: Freeze lifted at 23:15 UTC by exec-signal. Closing thread, file follow-up doc with cache tuning and rollback timeline for postmortem.
